---
name: New game support
about: Ask for a new daily game's shared results to be tallied
title: "Support <game name> results"
labels: "enhancement"
assignees: ""
---

**The game**
Name and link (e.g. https://example-dle.net), and roughly how it's played.

**Real share texts (the important bit)**
Paste two or three *real* results as people actually share them in Discord, each in
its own code block. Exact characters matter — emoji, punctuation, line breaks —
because the parser is built from these:

```
sample 1
```

```
sample 2 (ideally a different kind of result: a bad day, a perfect, a skip...)
```

**What should the leaderboard rank?**
Higher score wins / lower time wins / streaks / something else? What would the
monthly board show per player?

**Quirks**
Anything unusual: no date in the share text? A puzzle number instead? Variable
number of rounds? Results that can be edited after posting?
